schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_resources (
token TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(token) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('web','desktop')),
schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL,project_id TEXT NOT NULL,metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(metadata_json)),
size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 52428800),written INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(written BETWEEN 0 AND size),
digest TEXT CHECK(digest IS NULL OR (length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,bound_source TEXT,bound_schedule_id TEXT,bound_revision INTEGER,
CHECK(digest IS NULL OR written=size),
CHECK((bound_source IS NULL AND bound_schedule_id IS NULL AND bound_revision IS NULL) OR (bound_source IS NOT NULL AND bound_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND bound_revision IS NOT NULL AND bound_source=source AND bound_schedule_id=schedule_id AND bound_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND digest IS NOT NULL)),
FOREIGN KEY(bound_source,bound_schedule_id) REFERENCES acp_scheduled_plans(source,schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS acp_resource_scope ON acp_plan_resources(source,schedule_id,project_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_plan_resource_chunks (
token TEXT NOT NULL,offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(offset>=0),content BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144),digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64),
PRIMARY KEY(token,offset),FOREIGN KEY(token) REFERENCES acp_plan_resources(token) ON DELETE CASCADE) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_resource_stage_budget BEFORE INSERT ON acp_plan_resources
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source IS NULL)>=3000 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size),0) FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source IS NULL)+NEW.size>134217728
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP resource staging capacity exceeded'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_resource_bound_budget BEFORE UPDATE ON acp_plan_resources
WHEN NEW.bound_source IS NOT NULL AND OLD.bound_source IS NULL AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source IS NOT NULL)>=20000 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size),0) FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source IS NOT NULL)+NEW.size>536870912)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP resource capacity exceeded'); END;
read: SELECT * FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE token=? AND source=? AND schedule_id=? AND project_id=?
expire: DELETE FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source IS NULL AND created_at<?
chunk: SELECT content,digest FROM acp_plan_resource_chunks WHERE token=? AND offset=?
chunks: SELECT offset,content,digest FROM acp_plan_resource_chunks WHERE token=? ORDER BY offset
advance: UPDATE acp_plan_resources SET written=written+? WHERE token=? AND written=? AND digest IS NULL
seal: UPDATE acp_plan_resources SET digest=? WHERE token=? AND written=size AND bound_source IS NULL
abort: DELETE FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE token=? AND source=? AND schedule_id=? AND project_id=? AND bound_source IS NULL
prune: DELETE FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE bound_source=? AND bound_schedule_id=? AND token NOT IN(SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
bind: UPDATE acp_plan_resources SET bound_source=source,bound_schedule_id=schedule_id,bound_revision=? WHERE token=? AND source=? AND schedule_id=? AND project_id=?
list: SELECT * FROM acp_plan_resources WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND project_id=? AND bound_revision=? ORDER BY token
